rationale: 候选第二命题为源文本逐字截断（止于『called E 2』），源文本后半关键命题全部缺失：『the training data of our E 2 -LLM only requires a short length (e.g., 4k)』『the training procedure on the short training context window is performed only once time』『based on RoPE position embeddings, we introduce two different augmentation methods on the scale and position index parameters』均未覆盖，含数值（4k）、次数（once）与方法数量（two）等关键命题遗漏，E3。
